(verb). thuyết phục

Ex: She's always easily persuaded.

accept

(verb). chấp nhận

Ex: He asked me to marry him and I accepted.

basis

(noun). Nền tảng

Ex: The basis of a good marriage is trust.

coincidental

(adjective). trùng hợp ngẫu nhiên

Ex: It's purely coincidental that we both chose to call our daughters Emma.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

indeed

(adverb). thật vậy, hiển nhiên

Ex: Thank you very much indeed!

observe

(verb). Quan sát

Ex: I want you to observe all the details.

parallel

(noun). tương đồng, tương tự

Ex: This tradition has no parallel in our culture.

reality

(noun). thực tại

Ex: He refuses to face reality

refuse

(verb). từ chối

Ex: She refused to accept that there was a problem.

spring from

(verb). Xuất phát; xuất thân

Ex: The idea for the novel sprang from a trip to India.

artistic

(adjective). thuộc về nghệ thuật

Ex: Love is a time-honoured subject of literary and artistic expression.

common

(adjective). chung, phổ biến

Ex:They share a common interest in photography.

ability

(noun). khả năng, năng lực

Ex: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.

amnesia

(noun). chứng quên

Ex: After the accident he suffered periods of amnesia.

chronic

(adjective). Mãn tính

Ex: chronic diseases/conditions Ex: There is a chronic shortage of teachers.

cognitive

(adjective). Liên quan đến nhận thức

Ex: They are studying the links between cognitive and linguistic development in young children.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Ex: Can you describe him to me?

engage

(verb). tham gia vào

Ex: The army was regularly engaged in combat.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

invent

(verb). Phát minh

Ex: Who invented the steam engine?

oblivious

(adjective). không nhận thức được, lơ đãng

Ex: Lydia seemed oblivious, lost in her own thoughts.

rare

(adjective). Hiếm hoi, hiếm

Ex: It is rare to find such loyalty these days.

retain

(verb). Giữ lại

Ex: He struggled to retain control of the situation.

uncertain

(adjective). không chắc chắn, không rõ ràng

Ex: Our future looks uncertain.

unpredictable

(adjective). Không thể đoán trước

Ex: The result is entirely unpredictable.

attempt

(verb). cố gắng, nỗ lực

Ex: I will attempt to answer all your questions.

confabulation

(noun). chứng bịa chuyện

Ex: Confabulation differs from lying in that the person is not consciously attempting to deceive.

deceive

(verb). lừa gạt, lừa dối

Ex: The company deceived customers by selling old computers as new ones.

error

(noun). lỗi

Ex: A simple error of judgement meant that there was not enough food to go around.

recollection

(noun). Hồi tưởng

Ex: I have no recollection of meeting her before.

seize

(verb). bắt lấy, nắm lấy

Ex: A Malaysian tycoon seized the chance to bid for the company, and won.

conceive

(verb). tưởng tượng

Ex: God is often conceived of as male.

invention

(noun). phát minh

Ex: The two friends started a company to market their invention.

significance

(noun). sự quan trọng, sự đáng kể

Ex: The new drug has great significance for the treatment of the disease.

verbal

(adjective). thuộc lời nói

Ex: The job applicant must have good verbal skills.

deceit

(noun). sự lừa dối

Ex: He was accused of lies and deceit.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

superfluity

(noun). sự thừa

Ex: The new director has said that there is a superfluity of staff in the organization, and that cuts must be made.

testimony

(noun). lời chứng, lời khai

Ex: Her claim was supported by the testimony of several witnesses.

taint

(verb). taint

Ex: The administration was tainted with scandal.

minister

(noun). bộ trưởng

Ex: She became minister of education in 2016.

claim

(noun). lời tuyên bố

Ex: The company had made false claims about its products.

involve

(verb). liên quan, bao hàm

Ex: The test will involve answering questions about a photograph.

collapse

(verb). sụp đổ

Ex: All opposition to the plan has collapsed.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

victory

(noun). sự chiến thắng, sự thắng lợi

Ex: Neither side is strong enough to achieve a military victory.

curious

(adjective). Tò mò

Ex: He is such a curious boy, always asking questions.

differ

(verb). khác, không giống

Ex: French differs from English in this respect.

distinction

(noun). Sự phân biệt rạch ròi

Ex: We need to draw a distinction between the two events.

express

(verb). bày tỏ, thể hiện

Ex: Teachers have expressed concern about the changes.

ingredient

(noun). Thành phần, nguyên liệu

Ex: Our skin cream contains only natural ingredients.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể, có lẽ

Ex: This is perhaps his best novel to date.

refine

(verb). trau chuốt

Ex: She has refined her playing technique over the years.

truth

(noun). sự thật

Ex: I knew the truth would come out in the end.

corral

(verb). dồn lại, nắm lấy, tóm lấy

Ex: Police corralled most of the demonstrators in a small area near the station.

conscious

(adjective). có nhận thức

Ex: She's very conscious of the problems involved.

define

(verb). Định nghĩa

Ex: The term ‘mental illness’ is difficult to define.

deliberately

(adverb). cố ý, chủ tâm

Ex: She's been deliberately ignoring him all day.

distort

(verb). xuyên tạc, bóp méo

Ex: Newspapers are often guilty of distorting the truth.

fabricate

(verb). bịa đặt

Ex: The evidence was totally fabricated.

intention

(noun). Ý định

Ex: I have no intention of going to the wedding.

misinterpret

(verb). hiểu sai

Ex: His comments were misinterpreted as a criticism of the project.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The company suffered huge losses in the last financial year.

statement

(noun). sự phát biểu, phát ngôn

Ex: He made a rather misleading statement.

distressed

(adjective). đau buồn

Ex: He was too distressed and confused to answer their questions.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

impossible

(adjective). không khả thi

Ex: Only a year ago and this would have seemed impossible.

obscurely

(adverb). mơ hồ, khó hiểu

Ex: They were making her feel obscurely worried.

omission

(noun). sự bỏ quên, điều bỏ quên

Ex: The play was shortened by the omission of two scenes.

uncertainty

(noun). Sự không chắc chắn, thiếu rõ ràng

Ex: There is considerable uncertainty about the company's future.

compulsion

(noun). mong muốn không chế ngự được

Ex: He felt a great compulsion to drive too fast.

narrate

(verb). trần thuật

Ex: She entertained them by narrating her adventures in Africa.

channel

(verb). chuyển hóa

Ex: He channels his aggression into sport.

compel

(verb). ép buộc

Ex: Last year ill health compelled his retirement.

insight

(noun). cái nhìn sâu sắc

Ex: There are many valuable insights in her book.

outlandish

(adjective). kỳ lạ

Ex: As the show progressed, it got ever more outlandish.

particularly

(adverb). một cách cụ thể

Ex: Traffic is bad, particularly in the city centre.

resonance

(noun). tính âm vang

Ex: Harry's personal conflicts become the central focus, and the emotional resonance is sufficient to power the film.’

universal

(adjective). Phổ cập khắp nơi

Ex: Such problems are a universal feature of old age.

playwright

(noun). Nhà viết kịch

Ex: The most notable of the playwrights are Aeschylus, Euripides and Sophocles.

content

(noun). nội dung

Ex: She hadn't read the letter and so was unaware of its contents.

in advance

(adverb). trước

Ex: People were evacuated from the coastal regions in advance of the hurricane.

literally

(adverb). Theo nghĩa đen

Ex: Idioms usually cannot be translated literally into another language.

accuse

(verb). buộc tội

Ex: She accused him of lying.

former

(adjective). trước đó

Ex: This beautiful old building has been restored to its former glory.

allegedly

(adverb). bị coi là

Ex: She was arrested for allegedly stealing a car.

arms

(noun). vũ khí

Ex: He's the world 's most notorious arms dealer.

dealer

(noun). nhà buôn

Ex: He's a dealer in second-hand cars

government

(noun). chính phủ

Ex: She is the government official in charge of the project.

stretch

(verb). Kéo dài

Ex: Stop stretching your sleeves like that!

charm

(noun). sức hấp dẫn

Ex: He was a man of great charm.

deem

(verb). coi là

Ex: I deem it an honour to be invited.

defence

(noun). phòng thủ

Ex: What points can be raised in defence of this argument?

display

(noun). sự phô bày, sự trưng bày

Ex: She slammed the door behind her in a display of ill-temper.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

flair

(noun). năng khiếu

Ex: She attributes her entrepreneurial flair and individualism to her upbringing.

indisputable

(adjective). không thể chối cãi

Ex: It is indisputable that the crime rate has been rising.

sincerity

(noun). sự chân thật

Ex: She spoke with total sincerity.

sections.title: Passage 3: Theory or Practice? - What is the point of research carried out by biz schools?
sections.html:
accredit

(verb). công nhận

Ex: The Arabs are usually accredited with the discovery of distillation.

adjunct

(noun). giảng viên tạm thời

Ex: adjunct professors/faculty Ex: Sometimes he is also assisted by an adjunct who will later represent him during absences.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

announce

(verb). công bố, thông báo

Ex: It was announced that new speed restrictions would be introduced.

assess

(verb). đánh giá

Ex: It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.

boundary

(noun). Ranh giới

Ex: Scientists continue to push back the boundaries of human knowledge.

carry out

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: The hospital is carrying out tests to find out what's wrong with her.

collaboration

(noun). sự cộng tác

Ex: It was a collaboration that produced extremely useful results.

component

(noun). Thành phần

Ex: Nitrogen is the main component of air.

critical

(adjective). cấp thiết, rất quan trọng

Ex: Industry leaders are working together to address this critical issue.

demand

(verb). yêu cầu, đòi hỏi

Ex: This is a very difficult piece of music to play - it demands a lot of concentration.

equip

(verb). trang bị

Ex: The centre is well equipped for canoeing and mountaineering.

esoteric

(adjective). bí truyền

Ex: Specialist dictionaries may be required to understand some of the more esoteric texts.

ethos

(noun). đặc tính, phong tục

Ex: Investing in arms companies is strongly against the group's ethos.

expand

(verb). Mở rộng

Ex: A child's vocabulary expands through reading.

expedition

(noun). Cuộc thám hiểm

Ex: He had made two expeditions to Spain to study wild plants.

frustrating

(adjective). gây bực bội

Ex: It's frustrating to have to wait so long.

fulfilling

(adjective). làm thỏa mãn

Ex: The job I'm doing at the moment is not very fulfilling.

hypothesis

(noun). Giả thuyết

Ex: There is little evidence to support these hypotheses.

ignore

(verb). Bỏ qua; làm lơ

Ex: I made a suggestion but they chose to ignore it.

income

(noun). Thu nhập

Ex: Tourism is a major source of income for the area.

insist

(verb). khăng khăng, cố nài

Ex: I didn't really want to go but he insisted.

institution

(noun). Tổ chức, viện

Ex: Harvard University is an internationally respected institution.

judge

(verb). đánh giá

Ex: You shouldn't judge her too harshly.

maintain

(verb). duy trì

Ex: The two countries have always maintained close relations.

original

(adjective). Nguyên bản, khởi nguồn

Ex: The room still has many of its original features.

pursuit

(noun). sự theo đuổi

Ex: She travelled the world in pursuit of her dreams.

segregation

(noun). Sự phân tách

Ex: The social structure was based on the policy of racial segregation.

struggle

(verb). Chật vật

Ex: The firm is struggling to cope with the demand for its products.

thrive

(verb). Phát triển mạnh

Ex: New businesses thrive in this area.

tuition

(noun). việc học/dạy kèm

Ex: She received private tuition in French.

demonstrate

(verb). Trình bày, minh hoạ

Ex: New research convincingly demonstrates that age-related memory loss is not inevitable.

evaluate

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: It's impossible to evaluate these results without knowing more about the research methods employed.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

impact

(noun). tác động

Ex: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

faculty

(noun). khoa

Ex: We are in a shrinking market as colleges and universities downsize their agricultural faculties.

research

(noun). nghiên cứu

Ex: His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.

controversial

(adjective). Gây tranh cãi

Ex: A controversial plan to build a new road has met with protests.

recommendation

(noun). Gợi ý

Ex: The council will follow any recommendations made by the fire investigators.

attempt

(noun). lần thử, nỗ lực

Ex: Ex: Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.

core

(noun). cốt lõi

Ex: Concern for the environment is at the core of our policies.

endeavor

(noun). nỗ lực

Ex: There have been great advances in the field of scientific endeavour.

justify

(verb). biện minh, chứng minh là đúng

Ex: Her success had justified the faith her teachers had put in her.

legitimate

(adjective). chính đáng

Ex: It seemed a perfectly legitimate question.

operate

(verb). Vận hành

Ex: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.

pedagogy

(noun). sư phạm

Ex: Perhaps the most important dimension of his pedagogy was the diversity of options.

reinforce

(verb). Củng cố, tăng cường

Ex: Success in the talks will reinforce his reputation as an international statesman.

stance

(noun). lập trường

Ex: What is the newspaper's stance on the war?

undertake

(verb). đảm đương, thực hiện

Ex: University professors both teach and undertake research.

characterize

(verb). Biểu thị đặc điểm, mô tả đặc điểm

Ex: How would you characterize the mood of the 1990s?

company

(noun). công ty

Ex: It is the world's largest software company.

corporate

(adjective). thuộc đoàn thể

Ex: All adults take corporate responsibility for the upbringing of the tribe's children.

exemplify

(verb). làm ví dụ cho

Ex: His food exemplifies Italian cooking at its best.

irrelevant

(adjective). không liên quan

Ex: That evidence is irrelevant to the case.

mention

(verb). nhắc đến, đề cập

Ex: I promised never to mention the incident again.

obvious

(adjective). Hiển nhiên

Ex: He agreed with obvious pleasure.

performance

(noun). hiệu suất công việc, sự thể hiện

Ex: Her academic performance has been inconsistent.

universally

(adverb). Phổ biến mọi nơi

Ex: This treatment is not universally available.

adequately

(adverb). đầy đủ

Ex: Manufacturers may lack the means to adequately test their product.

criticism

(noun). chỉ trích

Ex: The plan has attracted criticism from consumer groups.

current

(adjective). hiện tại

Ex: Oil prices are expected to remain at current levels.

damning

(adjective). chỉ trích

Ex: Her report is expected to deliver a damning indictment of education standards.

guise

(noun). lốt, vỏ

Ex: His speech presented racist ideas under the guise of nationalism.

question

(verb). nghi ngờ

Ex: It never occurs to them to question the doctor's decisions.

sustainable

(adjective). Có thể duy trì lâu dài; Thân thiện với môi trường

Ex: This type of farming is simply not sustainable any more.

career

(noun). Sự nghiệp

Ex: He had a successful career in television journalism.

actually

(adverb). thực sự

Ex: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.

debate

(noun). Tranh luận

Ex: Many of these points were raised during the debate on prison reform.

flare

(verb). bùng cháy

Ex: Violence flared when the police moved in.

provoke

(verb). kích thích, thúc đẩy

Ex: Test results provoked worries that the reactor could overheat.

reignite

(verb). làm cháy lại

Ex: Their passion was reignited by a romantic trip to Venice.

vigorous

(adjective). sôi nổi, mãnh liệt

Ex: She was a vigorous opponent of the government.

administrator

(noun). quản trị viên

Ex: Such organizational decisions are made by the hospital administrators.

externally

(adverb). bên ngoài

Ex: The university has many externally funded research projects.

business

(noun). việc kinh doanh, việc thương mại

Ex: There will be some changes to the way we conduct business.

expensive

(adjective). đắt

Ex: Art books are expensive to produce.

fruitful

(adjective). Hiệu quả

Ex: The research has proved extremely fruitful.

output

(noun). năng suất

Ex: Last year manufacturing output fell by 14 percent.

pursue

(verb). Theo đuổi

Ex: She wishes to pursue a medical career.

redirect

(verb). đổi hướng

Ex: Resources are being redirected to this important new project.

specialise

(verb). chuyên về

Ex: He specialized in criminal law.

sum

(noun). tổng số

Ex: This is the sum of my achievements so far.

attract

(verb). thu hút

Ex: This proposal has attracted a lot of interest.

funding

(noun). kinh phí

Ex: There have been large cuts in government funding for scientific research.

publication

(noun). ấn phẩm

Ex: The study is published this week as an advance online publication.

mantra

(noun). câu slogan

Ex: the environmental mantra of ‘reduce, reuse, recycle’

perish

(verb). tàn lụi

Ex: Early buildings were made of wood and have perished.

publish

(verb). công bố

Ex: He works for a company that publishes reference books.

cement

(verb). tăng cường, củng cố

Ex: The president's visit was intended to cement the alliance between the two countries.

gain

(verb). đạt được, giành được

Ex: The country gained its independence ten years ago.

kudos

(noun). thanh danh

Ex: There was considerable kudos attached to being on the advisory board.

receive

(verb). nhận được

Ex: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.

record

(noun). ghi chép

Ex: You should keep a record of your expenses.

reputation

(noun). danh tiếng

Ex: The company enjoys an international reputation for quality of design.

innovative

(adjective). mang tính sáng tạo

Ex: There will be a prize for the most innovative design.

process

(noun). quá trình

Ex: It's a normal part of the learning process.

progress

(verb). tiến triển, phát triển

Ex: The course allows students to progress at their own speed.

society

(noun). xã hội

Ex: Every section of society must have access to education.

choice

(noun). sự lựa chọn

Ex: There is a wide range of choices open to you.

prepare

(verb). chuẩn bị

Ex: A hotel room is being prepared for them.

resist

(verb). cưỡng lại, kháng lại

Ex: They are determined to resist pressure to change the law.

trend

(noun). Xu hướng

Ex: There is a growing trend towards later retirement.
